args:
version="${COVERAGE_MCP_VERSION:?COVERAGE_MCP_VERSION is required}"
expected="coverage-mcp ${version}"
path_binary="$(command -v coverage-mcp 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -n "${path_binary}" ] && [ "$("${path_binary}" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" = "${expected}" ]; then
  exec "${path_binary}" connect
fi
runtime_base="${COVERAGE_MCP_RUNTIME_DIR:-${HOME:?HOME is required}/.coverage-mcp/runtime}"
runtime_root="${runtime_base}/${version}"
runtime_binary="${runtime_root}/bin/coverage-mcp"
matches_runtime() {
  [ -x "${runtime_binary}" ] && [ "$("${runtime_binary}" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" = "${expected}" ]
}
download_root=""
staged_binary=""
cleanup_download() {
  if [ -n "${staged_binary}" ]; then rm -f "${staged_binary}"; fi
  if [ -n "${download_root}" ]; then rm -rf "${download_root}"; fi
}
download_prebuilt() {
  system="$(uname -s 2>/dev/null || true)"
  machine="$(uname -m 2>/dev/null || true)"
  target=""
  case "${system}:${machine}" in
    Darwin:arm64|Darwin:aarch64) target="aarch64-apple-darwin" ;;
    Darwin:x86_64|Darwin:amd64) target="x86_64-apple-darwin" ;;
    Linux:aarch64|Linux:arm64) target="aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;;
    Linux:x86_64|Linux:amd64) target="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  checksum_tool=""
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    checksum_tool="sha256sum"
  elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    checksum_tool="shasum"
  else
    return 1
  fi
  mkdir -p "${runtime_base}"
  download_root="$(mktemp -d "${runtime_base}/.${version}.${target}.XXXXXX")" || return 1
  trap cleanup_download 0 1 2 15
  asset="coverage-mcp-${version}-${target}.tar.gz"
  release_base="https://github.com/appunni-m/coverage-mcp/releases/download/v${version}"
  if ! curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --retry 3 --silent --show-error "${release_base}/SHA256SUMS" --output "${download_root}/SHA256SUMS"; then
    cleanup_download
    trap - 0 1 2 15
    return 1
  fi
  if ! curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --retry 3 --silent --show-error "${release_base}/${asset}" --output "${download_root}/${asset}"; then
    cleanup_download
    trap - 0 1 2 15
    return 1
  fi
  expected_checksum="$(awk -v asset="${asset}" '$2 == asset { print $1 }' "${download_root}/SHA256SUMS")"
  if [ -z "${expected_checksum}" ]; then
    echo "Release checksums do not contain ${asset}." >&2
    cleanup_download
    trap - 0 1 2 15
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ "${checksum_tool}" = "sha256sum" ]; then
    actual_checksum="$(sha256sum "${download_root}/${asset}" | awk '{ print $1 }')"
  else
    actual_checksum="$(shasum -a 256 "${download_root}/${asset}" | awk '{ print $1 }')"
  fi
  if [ "${actual_checksum}" != "${expected_checksum}" ]; then
    echo "Checksum verification failed for ${asset}." >&2
    cleanup_download
    trap - 0 1 2 15
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! tar -xzf "${download_root}/${asset}" -C "${download_root}"; then
    echo "Could not extract verified release archive ${asset}." >&2
    cleanup_download
    trap - 0 1 2 15
    exit 1
  fi
  candidate="${download_root}/coverage-mcp-${version}-${target}/coverage-mcp"
  if [ ! -x "${candidate}" ] || [ "$("${candidate}" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "${expected}" ]; then
    cleanup_download
    trap - 0 1 2 15
    return 1
  fi
  mkdir -p "${runtime_root}/bin"
  staged_binary="${runtime_root}/bin/.coverage-mcp.$$"
  cp "${candidate}" "${staged_binary}"
  chmod 755 "${staged_binary}"
  mv -f "${staged_binary}" "${runtime_binary}"
  staged_binary=""
  cleanup_download
  trap - 0 1 2 15
}
if ! matches_runtime; then
  download_prebuilt || true
fi
if ! matches_runtime; then
  if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "No compatible prebuilt ${expected} binary was available and Cargo is not installed." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! cargo install coverage-mcp --version "=${version}" --locked --bin coverage-mcp --root "${runtime_root}"; then
    matches_runtime || exit 1
  fi
fi
if ! matches_runtime; then
  echo "Could not install ${expected} at ${runtime_binary}." >&2
  exit 1
fi
exec "${runtime_binary}" connect
